audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First item were given to Volibear, and Level 1 and 2+ items were marked Skill. The mirror (malphite__volibear) flipped Level 6 and First item to Malphite and left levels 2-5 with Volibear; the packet chart also gives Volibear Level 1 and Malphite the 2+ items row. The old rows contradicted the page's own whys[0] ('Level 1 is yours') and whys[6] ('he out-scales you').
audit.why: Malphite's armour, Granite Shield and Ground Slam's attack-speed cut all land in the item stages, which is exactly what Volibear's ramping passive needs.
audit.corrected: Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite on both layers, ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Volibear's strongest window and the ultimates were treated as a fair exchange.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s at 1000 range; Stormbringer is 160/135/110s at 550. He has his ultimate up more often and from further away — the level-6 row belongs to him.
audit.corrected: The 130s-versus-160s gap is now stated in phases[4].why and spikes[1], with the leap held for his engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked only his ultimate ('saved for fights, lane is fine without it') and never mentioned Ground Slam or Granite Shield — the two abilities that actually decide the trades.
audit.why: Ground Slam is 7s flat and reduces attack speed, which directly attacks Volibear's passive (attacks and abilities grant attack speed, then add bonus magic damage). Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges when he goes unhit, so a trade that does not break it does nothing at all.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam's 7s attack-speed cut and Granite Shield's 10% absorb are now the tracked interactions; Thundering Smash remains the stun and Frenzied Maul's second cast into the same mark the heal.

audit.why: The armour-pen line in the tldr and dosFull[2].t is right for this matchup — Granite Shield plus stacked armour is what blunts the on-hit bites — and it is already present.
audit.corrected: Kept, with the shield's 10% figure added so the advice is concrete.

edits.before: His armor blunts you — buy armor pen, Q-stun when he steps up. Volibear wins by trading around Malphite's Unstoppable Force and cashing the pattern: armor pen + all-in his immobility.
edits.after: His armour blunts you — Granite Shield eats 10% of his max health first, so break it, then Thundering Smash in. Kill him in the first five levels: Ground Slam (7s) shreds your attack speed later.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ground Slam (E): 7s flat — it cuts your attack speed, which is your passive's whole engine, so bite in the gap after he uses it.

edits.before: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max health — break it before you commit.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The second Frenzied Maul on a marked target is your heal — no mark, no sustain.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Malphite under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower, but Unstoppable Force is 130s to your 160s — he has the ultimate up more often than you do.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Malphite to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his health first — armour pen matters more than raw damage.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Malphite can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items his armour wall shrugs off your combo — Ground Slam also cuts your attack speed, so take objectives instead of the duel.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his R is a defensive/teamfight tool you answer with your own R.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Unstoppable Force is 130s against your Stormbringer's 160s.

edits.before: First item is a skill window as his armor and passive shield start blunting you.
edits.after: First item is his: armour and Granite Shield blunt your on-hit bites now.

edits.before: His R Unstoppable Force is a point-and-click knockup, but it's mainly a teamfight tool — in lane you hold your R Stormbringer to answer his engage, keeping the level roughly even.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range knockup on 130s at rank 1 while Stormbringer is 160s — he has it up more often, so hold your leap for his engage rather than starting fights at 6.

notes: Malphite's Q and E both carry a 'grounding' derived flag (shuts off enemy dashes) that Riot's own descriptions do not support — Seismic Shard steals move speed, Ground Slam reduces attack speed. If that flag were real it would deny Stormbringer's leap and would change every engage line on this page, so it is flagged rather than written. Volibear's E likewise carries a 'projectile' flag contradicting its description; no Wind Wall claim written. The mirror noted the Malphite content layer had fabricated Volibear ability names; on this side the names are already correct.
